Runtime: one buffApply per fullBurstStart, targetSlug liberalio only; removal lowers her total; a 9s window RAISES it. Fails under: line dropped, stat modeled as casterAtkPct, window stretched to the 10s FB length, or target widened to allies (teammate-inertness check).

Structural: buff attackDamagePct=20.83, durationSec=60, target self, block.requiresCore===true, per-shot trigger. Runtime: dropping requiresCore must INCREASE both the buffApply count and her damage (proves the gate is real AND non-vacuous in-fixture); a 0.5s window must LOSE damage. Fails under: generic (ungated) charge trigger, atkPct instead of attackDamagePct, or a sub-cadence duration. Note: 60s refreshed per core charge is indistinguishable from 'continuous' in 180s, so only a sub-cadence counterfactual is used (a '60->5s' patch would move nothing at her ~2s cadence).

fixtures: controlComp('liberalio', true) for every run — liter B1 / crown B2 / liberalio B3 / helm B3, Fire boss, focus liberalio, deterministic (no seed). B1+B2 are mandatory: a lone Burst III casts nothing and makes ZERO full bursts, which would vacuum every FB-enter and burst assertion. The fixed second Burst III (helm) is kept ON deliberately for two reasons — s1d's 'the 1 Burst-III ally with the lowest final ATK' is only a real target-set choice when a second B3 exists, and burst-cast vs full-burst-enter is only separable when another B3 can complete a rotation. 14 hoisted runs total (1 base + 13 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals), all under the ~20-run budget; counterfactual patches are located by EFFECT SIGNATURE (stat+value / flatDamage-in-slot) rather than block index, so authoring order does not matter, and slotBlocks() tolerates both documented override shapes (slot -> Block[] and slot -> {blocks: Block[]}) because the harness contract states them inconsistently. Duration counterfactuals deliberately use 0.5s rather than a merely-shorter window: at her ~2s charge cadence any window >= ~4s refreshes into permanence and would be a fake discriminator. (No filesystem tools were available in this run — the test source is returned inline only; the orchestrator must persist it to scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/liberalio.test.ts and this JSON to scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/liberalio.test-spec.json.)
gaps: skill1c '⚑ Activates 5 times multiplicity: 5 instances per charge vs 1' — prose gives no per-trigger/per-battle qualifier; the engine has no per-battle activation-cap primitive; recipe = count additional-damage popups per single full charge in footage (5 equal small popups vs 1), cross-checked against rider-contribution / (925% x burst casts) ~4-5 vs ~1.

skill1d '⚑ 12.74% OF THE SKILL USER''S Charge Speed is caster-scaled' — chargeSpeedPct scales the holder's own charge speed; there is no casterChargeSpeedPct analogue to casterAtkPct, so the grant is approximated by the flat 12.74 and the difference is unobservable from totals.

skill1d '⚑ self-grant vs the s2c immunity' — liberalio is herself an eligible Burst III target; if the lowest-final-ATK resolution picks her, the faithful outcome is a NO-OP (she is permanently immune to Increase Charge Speed), but no immunity primitive exists, so a self-resolution silently over-credits.

skill2b 'GAP — Fixes charge time at 1 sec is a stat CLAMP; no engine primitive' — chargeSpeedPct scales rather than pins, and the Gentle Current branch is unreachable on a single-stage-target boss (no non-stage-target Rapture in v1), so it is doubly inert.

skill2c 'GAP — permanent immunity to Increase/Decrease Charge Speed' — no immunity/ward primitive in the effect schema, and non-vacuously untestable in the control comp (liter/crown/helm grant no charge-speed effects), so a correct implementation would be observationally silent.
